papers.title: Fast Gaussian Process Regression for Big Data
papers.abstract: Gaussian Processes are widely used for regression tasks. A known limitation in the application of Gaussian Processes to regression tasks is that the computation of the solution requires performing a matrix inversion. The solution also requires the storage of a large matrix in memory. These factors restrict the application of Gaussian Process regression to small and moderate size data sets. We present an algorithm that combines estimates from models developed using subsets of the data obtained in a manner similar to the bootstrap. The sample size is a critical parameter for this algorithm. Guidelines for reasonable choices of algorithm parameters, based on detailed experimental study, are provided. Various techniques have been proposed to scale Gaussian Processes to large scale regression tasks. The most appropriate choice depends on the problem context. The proposed method is most appropriate for problems where an additive model works well and the response depends on a small number of features. The minimax rate of convergence for such problems is attractive and we can build effective models with a small subset of the data. The Stochastic Variational Gaussian Process and the Sparse Gaussian Process are also appropriate choices for such problems. These methods pick a subset of data based on theoretical considerations. The proposed algorithm uses bagging and random sampling. Results from experiments conducted as part of this study indicate that the algorithm presented in this work can be as effective as these methods. Model stacking can be used to combine the model developed with the proposed method with models from other methods for large scale regression such as Gradient Boosted Trees. This can yield performance gains.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的快速高斯过程回归方法可扩展应用于大规模代理模型，但未涉及约束处理与生物力学场景。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on scalable GP regression for big data without addressing constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服高斯过程回归在大数据下的计算和存储瓶颈。
summary_zh.method: 采用类似自助法的子集采样和模型集成来近似全局GP。
summary_zh.result: 所提方法在多个数据集上与稀疏GP和变分GP效果相当。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个大规模回归数据集进行实验对比。

summary_en.motivation: To scale Gaussian Process regression to large datasets by addressing computational and memory constraints of matrix inversion.
summary_en.method: Proposes an ensemble of GPs trained on bootstrap-sampled subsets of data to approximate the full GP posterior.
summary_en.result: The bagging-based GP achieves competitive predictive performance compared to sparse and variational GP methods on several large-scale benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Experimental evaluation on multiple large regression datasets with comparison to state-of-the-art scalable GP methods.
